examples.title: Finding Cause and Effect
examples.problem: Read: 'It rained heavily. The ground became muddy.' Why did the ground become muddy?
steps: Identify the result: 'The ground became muddy'.
Identify what happened just before it: 'It rained heavily'.
Connect them: The rain caused the mud.

examples.title: Identifying Character Motives
examples.problem: Read: 'Ravi was hungry, so he went to the kitchen.' Why did Ravi go to the kitchen?
steps: Identify the action: Ravi went to the kitchen.
Identify the reason mentioned: He was hungry.
State the motive: His motive was to find food because he was hungry.
